item.title: RPI Service Day | Saturday, Sept. 26
item.description: Date: Saturday, September 26, 2026 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM - A day of community service open to the entire RPI community to volunteer at a variety of local organizations like parks, food banks, gardens, and more, plus on-campus opportunities for service. Food and transportation will be provided! Sign up here: https://forms.gle/f7rpqjT6JhBc8SBb9 Questions? Join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/52EWRkBgA4 Or email serviceday@apoez.org

item.title: School of Engineering Receives Transformational Naming Gift for ECSE | October 9 Campus Celebration
item.description: This week, the School of Engineering celebrated a $27 million donation to ECSE from Doug Mercer ’77. In recognition of his transformational generosity and long-term commitment to ECSE, the department will be renamed the Douglas A. Mercer ’77 Department of Electrical, Computer, and Systems Engineering. A formal ceremony open to the RPI community will be held on October 9 at 9:00 AM at EMPAC. More details will be shared in the coming weeks

item.title: RPI Semiconductor CoLab Catalyst Seminar Series – October 2026
item.description: The RPI Semiconductor CoLab Catalyst Seminar Series brings together faculty, researchers, and industry partners to share ideas, highlight collaborations, and advance semiconductor and microelectronics innovation. The seminar on October 20th, at the Albany NanoTech Complex, features Jacob Merson (RPI) and Dureseti (Chidu) Chidambarrao (IBM) in two 45-min talks and a networking break. Faculty and students are invited, registration is required, transportation is possible. Follow the links..

item.title: RPI Faculty and Staff In-Person Workshop: Talk Smart, Teach Strong: Sharpening Your Academic Presentation Skills
item.description:
Date: Wednesday, September 30, 2026 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM - This session aims to strengthen academic presentation and facilitation skills, combining elements of presentation best practices with effective teaching strategies. You will explore techniques to enhance voice, presence, and impact in the classroom, while also engaging in train-the-trainer methods to foster active student participation. Please register by 9/25 using the Event URL in the See section of the calendar event.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
